mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 30 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School under clear skies with a waxing crescent moon overhead, and we are looking at an overnight low of 30 degrees with no rain expected.

The Verona Plan Commission is meeting on December 7th to review site plans for the Sub-Zero project in the Liberty Business Park, while residents are reminded that election notices for the November general election are now available.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run today, plus tomorrow you can catch the Dane County Farmer's Market, live music at Paddy Mac's, and the music of John Denver at the Fine Arts Center.
On October 25, officers located a driver at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue who had been stationary for at least 20 minutes; the individual was subsequently arrested for an O W I.
